title: docs(skills): objectstack-automation teaches the emailField recipient, flow requiredPermissions, excludeSubmitter and the screen file field
body:
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8GtSu7285zjAYqM8VgQB5Gr)_ Fixes #26298 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：objectstack-automation 技能包补上四条审计缺口 —— `notify` 收件人的第四种写法 `{ emailField }`（给非用户的申请人发邮件；CEL 信封算出的地址若无用户持有，节点运行时失败）、流程级 `requiredPermissions`（谁能启动流程）、审批节点 `excludeSubmitter`（提交人不能批自己的单；与 `auto_approve` 并写被拒）、屏幕字段 `type: 'file'`（续跑拿到 `sys_file` id，后续写入记录即认领文件）；每条配一条 eval。 - 为什么改：这四个键在 spec 里已存在，技能包零命中；AI 作者照现有文本写出的 `recipients` 信封现在会在运行时失败，不写 `excludeSubmitter` 则提交人可自批。 - 风险与回滚：只改已发布技能文本与 eval，不改运行时；token 天花板三行按实测余额上调（你 2026-10-27 的裁决 A）。回滚 = revert 本 PR。 - 先看：`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`（`notify` 代码块与 `requiredPermissions` 引言段）、`references/state-machines-and-approvals.md`（配置表新行、删掉的两条最佳实践）、`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`（三行上限）。 - 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` —— 预期末行 `81 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`，automation 三行 headroom 0。 - 需要你做的：批准（Approve）或「Merge when ready」—— `skills/**` 是 Tier H，席位不入队。 ## What changes Four rows from the skills gap audit (#26184, Part A § objectstack-automation, rows A1–A4), each taught in the fewest lines an AI author needs: | Row | Where | Teaching | |:--|:--|:--| | A3 `{ emailField }` | `SKILL.md` `notify` block, the `recipients` line | the fourth recipient form `{ emailField: 'applicant_email' }` (an `email`-typed field of the trigger record, for a non-user), `channels: 'email'` alone beside it, and that a CEL envelope must yield user ids — an address no user holds fails the node (`packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts` `NotifyEmailFieldRecipientSchema`, the `recipients` describe and the `channels` refinement) | | A1 `requiredPermissions` | `SKILL.md`, a blockquote after *Elevate the write, not the flow* | flow-level `requiredPermissions` is checked at every door that starts the flow by name; an action starting it inherits the list; a `subflow` node is not a door; gate an elevated `screen` / `api` flow here, never on `current_user.positions` (`flow.zod.ts` `requiredPermissions`, ADR-0066 D4) | | A4 screen `file` field | `SKILL.md` node table, the `screen` row | `config.fields[]` shape; `type: 'file'` renders the upload widget and resumes with the `sys_file` id bound to `name`; a later `create_record` / `update_record` writes it into a `file` field, which claims the file — collect first, write after the last screen (`builtin-node-config.zod.ts` `ScreenFieldConfigSchema.type`) | | A2 `excludeSubmitter` | `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md`, the Node Config table | drops the run's submitter from the resolved slate; an emptied slate takes the `onEmptyApprovers` route; `onEmptyApprovers: 'auto_approve'` is refused beside it (`approval.zod.ts` `excludeSubmitter`, `checkExcludeSubmitterPolicyPairing`) | Three eval prompts in `evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json`, in the file's existing shape: #6 the card's acceptance eval (email the applicant → `recipients: { emailField: … }`), #7 `requiredPermissions` + `excludeSubmitter` on one approval, #8 the screen `file` field written by a later `create_record`. **Paid down first (surviving homes named):** - `SKILL.md` CRM Blueprint, the *Approval flow* row restated `approvers` / `behavior` / `lockRecord` / `approvalStatusField` and the `approve` / `reject` branching — cut to a pointer; the surviving home is `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` § Node Config (`ApprovalNodeConfigSchema`) and § Branching, side-effects & rejection. - `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` Approval Best Practices 1 (*Gate entry on the edge*) and 4 (*Model rejection as a visible branch*) restated § Branching's *Conditional step*, *Roll back on reject* and *Hard reject* bullets and the section lead "wired on the graph, not in node config" — deleted; items 2, 3, 5 (each carrying a rationale found nowhere else) stay, renumbered. - Nothing else is removed. `SKILL.md` line 1 (the `version:` stamp PR #25640 owns) is untouched. **Token ratchet (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`), the measured remainder per file, under the maintainer's ruling.** The decision card asked 「skills 修复卡的教学和 eval 都撞 token 天花板,怎么付?」; Warren's tap, 2026-10-27, verbatim: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」. | File | lines before → after | tokens before → after | ceiling before → after | |:--|:--|:--|:--| | `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` | 432 → 441 | 5771 → 6004 (+233 net; ~17 paid by the Blueprint cut; 9 absorbed by headroom) | 5780 → 6004 (+224) | | `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` | 383 → 380 | 5555 → 5587 (+32 net; ~73 paid by the two deleted practices; 14 absorbed) | 5569 → 5587 (+18) | | `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` | 55 → 85 | 1255 → 1823 (+568; nothing in the file to delete) | 1255 → 1823 (+568) | | `references/examples-flows.md`, `references/_index.md` (generated) | 134, 46 (unchanged) | 1421, 919 (unchanged) | — | | **Whole package** (`SKILL.md` + `references/**/*.md` + `rules/**/*.md`) | **995 → 1001** | **13666 → 13931** (authored 12747 → 13012) | — | ## Why The audit measured 0 hits in the package for `requiredPermissions`, `excludeSubmitter` and `emailField`; `SKILL.md`'s `recipients` comment read "id, list, or envelope", which since `d1e329e96d` sends an author mailing an applicant into a run-time failure; the approval config table had no `excludeSubmitter` row, so a submitter could approve their own request; screen field types were not enumerated. The premise was re-read on `origin/main` at `756220c4` before the first edit and holds (the seat's read-only check of 2026-10-27 00:36Z, re-measured here: `grep -rn` of the three keys over `skills/objectstack-automation/` → 0 hits; the screen `file` type's spec location is `ScreenFieldConfigSchema.type` in `packages/spec/src/automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts`, which the seat had not located). ## Tests No runtime code changes; the eval file parses (`python3 -c json.load` → ok) and the package gates below read the new text. The three eval prompts are the test surface for the teachings. ## Acceptance notes - `check:skill-examples` has three surfaces; the skills + docs surface is the one this PR touches. Its verdict needs `packages/spec`, `@objectstack/client` and `@objectstack/client-react` built first (it refuses with exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, otherwise) — see Verification for the run against the built tree. - Six commits the card cites (`49653f9181`, `4bcc4df649`, `6021b5e837`, `d1e329e96d`, `6d9d3ef857`, `f1ddace887`) are outside this container's shallow clone (`git cat-file -e` → missing); the spec text on `main` was read directly instead, so the teachings quote what `main` holds, not the commits. - No out-of-scope findings: nothing reproducible, no contract breach, no new authoring trap beyond the four the card names. ## Verification Gate list derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the final tree (`83b5ec5e`), 54 commands, every exit code captured before any pipe, reconciled with `--ran`.
Derived gates — 53 commands, 52 run green, 1 NOT MEASURED (--ran exit 0) - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran ran.list --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → `53 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 52 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`, exit 0; change set `4 path(s) vs merge base 756220c4a`, `changed lines: 85 (+72 / -13)`. - NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` → exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET — some package has no dist/` (33 packages unbuilt in this container; a repo-wide build is CI's run). CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` carries it. - Two gates raced this thread's own concurrent builds in the batch and were re-run alone, the re-run codes recorded: `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs` (first run `ENOENT … packages/spec/.examples-build/…`, a transient dir the concurrent `check:skill-examples` run was materialising; re-run exit 0, `18308 files, 0 disagree, 0 unparseable`); `pnpm check:dts-closure` (first run while `@objectstack/client-react` was mid-build under the verify lock; re-run exit 0, `38 built package(s) swept - 160/160 declared declaration file(s) present`). - `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exit 0 — `81 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`; automation rows `6004 / 6004 (+0)`, `1823 / 1823 (+0)`, `5587 / 5587 (+0)`; `--self-test` exit 0, `79 cases pass`. - `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` exit 0, `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges` exit 0, `pnpm check:ratchet-remedy-authority` exit 0 (all in the batch).
The card's three package gates and the liveness gate - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-docs` exit 0 — `✅ Skill docs in sync`. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-refs` exit 0 — `✅ 9 generated files in sync with packages/spec` (`references/_index.md` unchanged, nothing to regenerate). - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` exit 0 after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` (lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`, 88 s) and `pnpm --filter "@objectstack/client-react..." build` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`, 304 s) — `✅ 264 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)`; the two earlier runs on an unbuilt tree exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`), not findings. - `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness` exit 0 — `Leg 1: 491 citation(s) over 69 published file(s) … Leg 2: 8 registered exhaustive section(s), 0 ledgered gap(s)`. - Not run locally (CI-owned, not derived): `pnpm lint`, `test:repo`, the full battery.
## Human Minimum - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (no schema change) - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no new names; keys quoted as the spec spells them) - [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run (repo-level scan, not owed locally per `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`). - [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. - [x] 5. Nothing publishes from a released package (`skills/**` carries no `package.json`); `skip-changeset`, and both declaration lines are above. - [x] 6. `packages/spec` untouched. - [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. - [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block and the quoted ruling are the repo's own exceptions). - [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01JQwxbXsLdroTYaf1DRqVUG)_
